name: MoneyLens
tagline: An AR budgeting assistant that warns you about a venue's cost to your budget as you walk in.

awards: [Warp] Expedited internship / full time interview process + Cash

solution: Connects bank data, learns spending habits and shows AR overlays at a venue with the expected impact on today's budget.
demo_moment: Team-described: point the camera at a café and see the budget glow.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Warp] Expedited internship / full time interview process + Cash” among 112 submissions.
Intervenes at the point of spending.

lessons: Nudges work best at the moment of decision.
